text:
Emily Chen: FYI nightly billing retried for Clippr Labs and ended up creating two invoices. One of them is missing the metered-usage add-on line and has a much lower total. I'm worried both were emailed.
Tom Hudson: Do you have the invoice ids + a sample of the payloads?
Emily Chen: IDs: INV-2026-00901 and INV-2026-00901-1. Payloads from the generator: 
```
{"id":"INV-2026-00901","customer":"Clippr Labs","lines":[{"desc":"subscription (Apr)","amount_cents":800000},{"desc":"metered add-on (video-mins)","amount_cents":450000},{"desc":"tax","amount_cents":25000}],"total_cents":1275000,"status":"issued"}
```
and the duplicate: 
```
{"id":"INV-2026-00901-1","customer":"Clippr Labs","lines":[{"desc":"subscription (Apr)","amount_cents":800000},{"desc":"tax","amount_cents":25000}],"total_cents":825000,"status":"issued"}
```
Emily Chen: You can see the metered add-on is absent from the second invoice. Billing Bot: mailer-service: delivered invoice INV-2026-00901-1 to billing@clippr.co at 2026-04-01T07:12:39Z 
Tom Hudson: Ugh. So two invoices issued and one undershot. Any sign of idempotency key problems in logs?
Billing Bot: billing-generator: WARNING at 2026-04-01T07:11:52Z ": idempotency check failed: expected key=retry-clippr-9 found=null; continued with fresh invoice id=INV-2026-00901-1" job=bgen-20260401-102
Ops Bot: promo-retry-worker: error 502 on write to kv-store at 2026-04-01T07:11:50Z; stacktrace attached to ticket ENG-5401.
Luis Rivera: Immediate action: void the incorrect invoice INV-2026-00901-1 and regenerate with the correct metered usage. Need finance lead approval to void issued invoices and to notify customer.
Emily Chen: Approve void + regenerate. Proceed. :white_check_mark:
Tom Hudson: Running steps now: 
```
# pause retry worker
opsctl worker pause promo-retry-worker
# void incorrect invoice (ledger mutation)
billing-cli invoice void --id INV-2026-00901-1 --reason "duplicate/partial" --force
# regenerate correct invoice with ledger update
ing-cli invoice regenerate --id INV-2026-00901 --include-metered --force
```
Tom Hudson: Commands completed. Void output: `{\"id\":\"INV-2026-00901-1\",\"status\":\"voided\"}`
Tom Hudson: Regen output: `{\"id\":\"INV-2026-00901\",\"lines\":[{\"desc\":\"subscription (Apr)\",\"amount_cents\":800000},{\"desc\":\"metered add-on (video-mins)\",\"amount_cents\":450000},{\"desc\":\"tax\",\"amount_cents\":25000}],\"total_cents\":1275000,\"status\":\"issued\"}`
Billing Bot: mailer-service: re-sent invoice INV-2026-00901 to billing@clippr.co at 2026-04-01T07:20:11Z
Luis Rivera: Thanks. Please open an engineering ticket to fix idempotency persistence and add a renderer validation that aborts PDF/email if expected metered lines are missing. Mark P1 for eng-billing.
Emily Chen: Filed ENG-5401: "Idempotency missing leads to duplicate/partial invoices" and added logs/steps to reproduce. Assigned to @eng-billing.
Tom Hudson: Notifying support to hold customer communication until we've confirmed final invoice and voided duplicate.
Emily Chen: Closing thread for now. Re-open if any customer dispute arrives or if more duplicates pop up.
